agentic.title: Agent-driven development
agentic.thesis: One developer running a fleet of coding agents like an engineering team: every task isolated, every change gated, every merge verified.
agentic.summary: All of Avinya's products live in one pnpm + Turborepo monorepo built so agents can work in parallel without colliding. Each task gets its own git worktree, database and ports. AGENTS.md files and a library of agent skills carry the architecture and the non-negotiable rules. Code must pass the same gates locally and in CI, a fresh reviewer agent attests to the exact commit, and a merge script refuses anything that does not match.

pipeline.title: Spec
pipeline.label: Issue to tickets
pipeline.detail: Work starts as an issue from a template. Agent skills (to-spec, to-tickets) turn it into small, claimable tickets.

pipeline.title: Isolate
pipeline.label: Worktree per task
pipeline.detail: Each task gets a fresh git worktree with its own database, ports and env files, so several agents build in parallel without stepping on each other.

pipeline.title: Context
pipeline.label: AGENTS.md + skills
pipeline.detail: Agents load the root and package AGENTS.md files, then the matching skill, before touching code. Invariants such as integer money and tenant isolation are written for machines.

pipeline.title: Build
pipeline.label: Agent ships a vertical slice
pipeline.detail: Schema, domain, server, UI and tests land together. Migrations are generated, never hand-edited. One concern per Conventional Commit.

pipeline.title: Gates
pipeline.label: Local gates mirror CI
pipeline.detail: Pre-commit and pre-push run a secret scan, typecheck, lint, unused-code checks, 17 dependency-boundary rules and the full test suite against a real Postgres. CI runs the same scripts.

pipeline.title: Review
pipeline.label: Fresh-agent review
pipeline.detail: An independent reviewer agent that never saw the author's session reviews the PR and attests to one exact commit SHA. Any new push invalidates the attestation.

pipeline.title: Merge
pipeline.label: SHA-bound merge gate
pipeline.detail: merge:ready refuses to merge unless the attestation SHA equals the head, CI is green and the PR is mergeable, then squash-merges that exact commit.

pipeline.title: Ship
pipeline.label: Deploy only what changed
pipeline.detail: Change detection deploys only the apps a merge touched to Cloudflare. A preview label spins up per-PR preview apps and database branches.

guardrails: Every task in its own worktree, database and ports
Invariants first: data integrity, tenant isolation, transactions, idempotency
Strict TypeScript, lint and unused-code checks as errors
17 dependency-boundary rules (no cross-app imports, no cycles)
Tests against a real Postgres before every push
Independent AI review bound to a commit SHA
Agents may not claim a gate passed unless they ran it

tooling.name: merge:ready

tooling.name: pr:sync + update-branches

projects.title: Avinya platform
projects.oneLiner: A monorepo of 4 production apps and 5 shared packages, built by one developer orchestrating coding agents.
projects.description: The engine behind Avinya IT: a multi-tenant wholesale distribution platform with offline order capture, an exam-prep workspace that drafts documents with AI and compiles them with Typst in the browser, a clinical notes workspace and an internal admin app, all sharing auth, UI and tooling packages. The repository is designed for agents: worktree isolation, AGENTS.md context, agent skills, local gates that mirror CI, independent AI review and a SHA-bound merge gate. Only the apps a merge touches are deployed.

projects.title: Dhi
projects.oneLiner: A desktop LLM wiki that ingests your documents and grows a linked knowledge graph.
projects.description: Tauri 2 desktop app with a React 19 front end. Documents go through a persistent LLM ingest queue and become linked notes in a Milkdown editor, visualised as a knowledge graph with community detection. Includes a Chrome clipper extension, property-based tests with fast-check, CI and cross-platform release builds.
highlights: Release builds for Linux and Windows

projects.title: Net Watch
projects.oneLiner: A native Android app that records network drops and 'dead air' on a timeline you can export.
projects.description: Kotlin and Jetpack Compose app with a background monitoring service, a Room database and an event timeline that flags connectivity drops and dead-air periods. Ships F-Droid / fastlane metadata, unit and instrumented tests, and product docs.

projects.title: agx
projects.oneLiner: A CLI that keeps the Antigravity agent IDE and CLI in sync, searchable and backed up.
projects.description: Python CLI (Typer + Rich) for Google Antigravity: bidirectional session index sync, full-text transcript search, trajectory diffing, backups and restores, a doctor health check and zero-touch subdomain tunnels for local dev ports. Three releases in two weeks, tag-built binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows.

projects.title: MedJot
projects.oneLiner: An offline-first clinic notebook that lets a solo doctor record a visit faster than a paper register.
projects.description: Mobile-first PWA where all data stays on the device (IndexedDB with live queries). Chip-based symptom capture with learned autocomplete over a pre-seeded dictionary of 100+ symptoms and 200+ medicines, a cmdk command palette, a dashboard for follow-ups and payments, PDF receipts on a letterhead, and backup and restore. Installable, with an update dialog.

projects.title: Anvika
projects.oneLiner: An admin and client dashboard for managing client data with real-time sync.
projects.description: Next.js application designed in Figma and built with shadcn/ui: an admin dashboard and a client portal for managing client data, with real-time syncing on a Supabase (PostgreSQL) backend.

projects.title: tabbb
projects.oneLiner: A Chrome new-tab page that groups your open tabs and makes closing them satisfying.
projects.description: Manifest V3 extension with a domain card grid, duplicate detection and 'save for later'. Closing a group plays a synthesised swoosh (Web Audio API) and confetti. A small study in delight as a UX feature.

projects.title: CryptoNow
projects.oneLiner: A crypto market dashboard with live prices, charts, trending coins and news.
projects.description: Next.js 15 dashboard on CoinGecko data with a cached API client and a daily request guard, a markets table, price charts with Recharts, and trending and news pages, built with shadcn/ui.
highlights: Cached API client with request budget

projects.title: Tantr
projects.oneLiner: An agentic learning and file-organisation app where agents must ask before they change anything.
projects.description: Agents work through a four-phase mutation protocol: read-only audit, manifest, human approval, then idempotent execution with hash verification. Deletions become quarantine, every batch has an undo script, and agents read and answer human annotations through a SQLite feedback loop.

projects.title: Business websites
projects.oneLiner: Booking, catalogue and studio websites for healthcare, food and wellness businesses.
projects.description: A hospital site with appointment booking (React, Express, Zod, Drizzle on Neon), a food e-commerce catalogue with cart, comparison and quote requests (Next.js 15, Tailwind 4, Framer Motion), and a wellness studio site with a guided breathing exercise and an accessibility page (Nuxt 4, Vuetify).

projects.title: AdhyAI

projects.description: Python app with a layered architecture (services, repositories, Alembic migrations), a Streamlit UI, an OpenRouter adapter with rate limiting, Kubernetes manifests and CI.
